scripts.study: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import {ensureStudyService} from './tools/study-service.js'; if(process.argv.length!==2) throw new Error('usage: npm run study -- /absolute/store'); const handle=await ensureStudyService(process.argv[1]); fs.writeSync(1,handle.studyUrl+'\n'); process.exit(0);" --
scripts.study:stop: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import {inspectStudyService,stopStudyService} from './tools/study-service.js'; if(process.argv.length!==2) throw new Error('usage: npm run study:stop -- /absolute/store'); const handle=await inspectStudyService(process.argv[1]); if(handle.status==='running') await stopStudyService(process.argv[1],{expectedInstanceId:handle.instanceId}); fs.writeSync(1,'학습 서비스를 정지했습니다.\n'); process.exit(0);" --
